_comment: Teaching strings for impossible pieces bounced off a Level-2 assembly. Curriculum, never hardcoded. Keyed by role. Latin has no augment; the role vocabulary here is stem/themeVowel/tenseMarker/moodMarker/ending/participialMorpheme/redup (family-conventions §2).
redup: reduplication: a handful of perfects only (dedī, stetī)
tenseMarker: no tense marker here — the present system builds straight on the stem
moodMarker: mood markers belong to the subjunctive, not the indicative
themeVowel: no separate theme vowel in this form
participialMorpheme: participial morphemes build verbal adjectives, not finite forms
